content: Awarded €227,000 as Co-Principal Investigator by the Gerda Henkel Stiftung for the project Contours of Future Democratic Society (2026–2028).
Not your mean green: beyond averages in mapping socio-spatial inequities in urban greenery published in EPJ Data Science.
greenR awarded the prestigious Prix Carto 2025 (Educational Category) by the Swiss Society of Cartography for advancing open-source urban greenness analysis.
Urban resilience through adaptive multifutures and nature-based solutions published in npj Urban Sustainability (Nature Portfolio).
Dynamic calibration of low-cost PM2.5 sensors using trust-based consensus mechanisms published in npj Climate and Atmospheric Science.
Appointed Senior Scientist & Lecturer at ETH Zurich in the Computational Social Science (COSS) group.
Co-creating the future: participatory cities and digital governance published in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A.
greenR: An open-source framework for quantifying urban greenness published in Ecological Indicators.
